subject: Staging bootstrap & peering commitment
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@novushealth.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staging bootstrap & peering commitment

Hi Karthik / Ben / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to lock in the evaluation run and need to align on the MAP items for environment activation so we can start traffic next month.

High level asks we need from Redwood to complete our internal gating:
- Org setup & tenant invite (we need an admin user + service account)
- API key provisioning and token TTL guidance
- IP allowlist format (CSV) and a sample of Redwood's egress ranges
- VPC peering: required CIDR ranges and a peering template to share with our network team

Attached is our short SOW and a procurement contact for the commercial side (Procurement <procure@novushealth.ai>). Target: evaluation window begins 2025-07-20. Can you confirm if the MAP can commit to the items below within two business days?

Requested timeline (Novus):
- 7/9: confirm org invite + API key approach
- 7/11: share allowlist template + proposed egress ranges
- 7/15: complete peering exchange and TEST traffic allowed

If those dates look tight, propose alternatives. Also propose a 30-minute kickoff this week (suggest Tue 7/8 10am PT) to walk the network steps.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Head of Platform, Novus Health
Attachments (stated): novus-eval-sow.pdf
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@novushealth.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging bootstrap & peering commitment

Sam — thanks for the clear asks. We can meet the core items but want to set realistic checkpoints. Quick summary from Redwood's side and an outline MAP below.

Redwood commitments (high level):
- Org setup: we'll create a Novus tenant and send invites to one admin + one service account by EOD 7/9. Service account will have scoped API keys and limited TTL (recommended 90d) unless you need longer.
- API keys: we will provide a short-lived service key and a guidance doc on rotation. For evaluation we can support a persistent test key with rate-limits.
- IP allowlist: attached is our network-allowlist-template.csv. Please confirm your public egress ranges; we'll also provide our egress CIDRs for testing.
- VPC peering: attach vpc-peering-template.docx and a standard peering checklist. We need your peer ASN and primary CIDR ranges (avoid overlap with 10.0.0.0/8 family preferred).

Mutual Action Plan (proposed)
- 2025-07-09: Redwood sends tenant invite, API key details, and allowlist template (action: Redwood)
- 2025-07-11: Novus returns allowlist CSV + network contact + procurement form (action: Novus)
- 2025-07-14: VPC peering request exchanged and ticket opened (action: both)
- 2025-07-15: Test traffic permitted; smoke tests run (action: both)

Open questions for Novus:
1) Can you confirm whether your network team requires BGP or a simple static peering? If BGP, please provide ASN.
2) Do you want the service account to be issued with cross-project/network permissions? We can scope to API-only.

I'll schedule the Tue 10am PT kickoff and include our network engineer Ben. If timing is wrong, propose alternatives.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sam Patel <sam@novushealth.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging bootstrap & peering commitment

Short note from infra side — Novus procurement will need our W-9 and SOW countersigned to open reserved resources on their side. Marissa, can you share the SOW amberline and a completed vendor form by 7/9 EOD?

Network notes for Novus team:
- Preferred peer CIDR: we recommend a /16 or /20 depending on your tenancy (share preferred ranges). Avoid using 172.16/12 if you have internal overlap.
- We support either static peering (fastest) or optional BGP sessions. Static is simpler for an eval.

Ben Carter
Infra & Capacity, Redwood Dedicated
Attachment referenced: vpc-peering-template.docx
From: Sam Patel <sam@novushealth.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procure@novushealth.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan@novushealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging bootstrap & peering commitment

Thanks Karthik/Ben — all clear. Procurement (procure@novushealth.ai) will send the vendor packet today. Our network is fine with static peering for the pilot; internal CIDR we'll share (10.40.0.0/16). Jordan (cc) is our DevOps lead and will own the peering exchange.

We accept the MAP dates you proposed. Confirming:
- 7/9: Redwood tenant invite + API key guidance expected — we'll watch for the invite
- 7/11: allowlist CSV will be submitted by our security team
- 7/15: target test traffic

Attachments I'll send to your team after Procurement opens the vendor record: novus-eval-sow.pdf (signed), network-allowlist.csv (filled), and our peering contact details.

Best,
Sam
